07-27.description: A Ukrainian Air Force Su-27 crashed into spectators during an aerobatic display at Sknyliv airfield near Lviv on 27 July 2002. The disaster killed 77 people, including 28 children, and injured hundreds.

07-28.title: Pakistan floods
07-28.description: Unprecedented monsoon rains in late July and August 2010 caused the Indus River and its tributaries to burst their banks, flooding nearly one-fifth of Pakistan's land area across 78 of its 121 districts. Official figures recorded 1,985 deaths and 2,946 injuries, while more than 20 million people were affected, making it one of the largest humanitarian disasters in modern history. The floods destroyed roughly 1.7 million homes, submerged vast agricultural areas, and forced the U.N. to launch a $2 billion relief appeal for what it called the worst flood disaster in Pakistan's history.

review.note: 1,985 dead, 2,946 injured and 20.2 million affected corroborated. Onset is a multi-day monsoon period rather than a verified July 28 instant. Housing total includes damaged as well as destroyed homes; the precise 78 districts and appeal wording were not fully established.

07-28.title: Kumamoto earthquake
07-28.description: An earthquake measured at magnitude 7.1 by Japan's Meteorological Agency struck Kumamoto at 16:27 local time on 28 July 2026. Prefectural figures as of 3 August recorded 38 deaths, 98 injuries and 8,383 evacuees. Damage included an explosion and collapse at Aeon Mall in Kashima and a chimney collapse at a paper mill in Yatsushiro.

07-29.title: Wayanad Landslides
07-29.description: Landslides struck Wayanad, Kerala, early on July 30, 2024 local time, July 29 UTC, after intense rain. A government answer to Parliament in April 2025 reported 298 deaths, including 32 missing people declared deceased, based on Kerala's official accounting.

07-29.title: Firefighting helicopter crash in San Juan kills seven
07-29.description: A Bell 412 helicopter contracted by Argentina's Federal Emergency Agency crashed near Ischigualasto Provincial Park in San Juan on 29 July 2026, killing all seven occupants. It had previously taken part in training and was travelling toward La Rioja to assist firefighting operations. Contact was lost at about 10:26 local time.

07-29.title: Militant drone-and-ambush attack on police checkpoint in Hangu
07-29.description: Militants, blamed by police on the Pakistani Taliban (TTP), launched a drone strike and ambush on the Khazina Banda police checkpoint in Hangu district on the evening of July 29, 2026, in an assault that also involved an attack on a neighbouring checkpost. Eleven police officers, including a deputy superintendent of police, were killed as the death toll rose through the following morning, with initial reports citing 9 to 10 officers dead and at least 28 injured; authorities said 15 attackers were also killed in the ensuing gunfight. It was the second major assault on security forces in the area within a week amid escalating attacks in the Afghanistan–Pakistan border region.

review.note: July 29 and 11 police dead supported; attackers killed differ (AP 15, ARY eight). Drone detail, prior assault comparison and precise UTC onset not established.

07-29.title: US–Saudi airstrikes kill 20 Iran-backed militiamen in Iraq as US strikes on Iran resume
07-29.description: As part of the 2026 Iran war, US Central Command and Saudi forces carried out joint strikes on positions of Iran-backed militias in Iraq on July 29, 2026, killing 20 Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF) militants, including several Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) members, according to the PMF. The same day, after a six-day pause, the US military resumed heavy waves of strikes against dozens of IRGC targets inside Iran in retaliation for an attempted missile attack on US forces in the Middle East a day earlier, an escalation that prompted Iranian retaliatory strikes on Kuwait days later.
sources: Wikipedia: July 2026 United States strikes against Iran

review.note: PMF reported 20 members killed. IRGC advisers may be additional. Overnight July 28-29 requires UTC check; resumed Iran strikes and causal link to Kuwait not fully established.

07-29.title: Wildfires in southern Greece kill three firefighters
07-29.location: Rethymno, Crete and Gytheio, Laconia, Greece
07-29.description: Three firefighters died during wildfire response operations in southern Greece on 29 July 2026. Two died in a fire in the Rethymno region of Crete. A third was found unconscious near a fire in the Gytheio area and pronounced dead in hospital; authorities had not established the cause of his death.

07-30.title: Darfur genocide (2004 killings)
07-30.description: The armed conflict in Darfur, in which the Sudanese government and allied Janjaweed militias systematically attacked civilian villages, killed tens of thousands of people and displaced more than a million during 2004. United Nations and WHO estimates of deaths in 2004 ranged from about 30,000 to 71,000, mostly from violence, starvation and disease.

review.note: 70,000 was WHO's estimated mortality among displaced people from living conditions in accessible Darfur areas during March-mid-October 2004, excluding violent deaths. It is neither all 2004 killings nor a July 30 event. Need a defensible interval, title and mortality scope; avoid overlap with the 2003 onset record.

07-30.title: Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh
07-30.description: Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh and his bodyguard were killed at a residence in Tehran around 2 a.m. on July 31, 2024 local time, July 30 UTC. Accounts differed over whether a projectile or a previously planted explosive caused the blast.

07-30.title: Broad Peak avalanche kills ten climbers
07-30.description: An avalanche struck ten climbers on Broad Peak in Pakistan's Karakoram range on the morning of 30 July 2026. All ten, including Nirmal Purja, were subsequently confirmed dead. Recovery operations continued after the first bodies were located, with weather and terrain hindering access.

07-30.title: Coal mine explosion in Balochistan
07-30.description: A methane gas explosion ripped through a coal mine in Balochistan province on 30 July, killing at least 34 miners. Rescue officials recovered 32 bodies and said two workers remained trapped in an inaccessible section of the mine.

review.note: AP reports 34 dead, 32 recovered and two to retrieve. July 30 occurrence versus July 31 publication distinguished. Exact time unavailable but no evidence of UTC crossover. Absence of evidence of a crossover does not establish the UTC date; withhold pending an onset time or sufficiently specific time-of-day account.

07-30.title: Russia launches massive missile and drone strike on Ukraine
07-30.location: Kyiv, Lviv and Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine
07-30.description: In the early hours of July 30, 2026, Russia launched one of its largest combined strikes of the war, firing dozens of ballistic and cruise missiles and hundreds of drones (President Zelensky cited over 70 missiles and 280 drones) at cities across Ukraine, with damage reported from east to west in Kyiv, Lviv and Kryvyi Rih. At least 10 civilians, including children, were killed and more than 50 injured, including six people killed by a ballistic missile strike on Kryvyi Rih and a family of six killed in a village hit by a suspected North Korean missile; NATO scrambled jets in response and a stray Russian cruise missile briefly entered Polish airspace.

review.note: 70 missiles/280 drones supported; Reuters nine deaths, EFE earlier eight, versus record ten. Family and Kryvyi Rih totals may overlap. Polish incursion and UTC onset not confirmed.

07-31.title: Kaohsiung Gas Explosions
07-31.description: A series of underground gas explosions ripped through streets in Kaohsiung, killing 32 people and injuring over 300. The blasts were caused by leaking propylene gas in sewer systems.
sources: Taiwan Ministry of Environment, incident review

07-31.title: Flash floods and landslides in Dien Bien Province
07-31.description: Flash floods and landslides struck Dien Bien Province early on 1 August 2025 local time (31 July UTC), after heavy rain. A subsequent provincial tally reported ten deaths and seven injuries. Homes and roads were damaged and several communities isolated.

07-31.title: Apartment building fire kills four in Changsha
07-31.description: A fire broke out at 03:54 local time on 1 August at a high-rise residential building in the Poly Lugu Linyu compound, Yuelu District, Changsha, killing four people and injuring two. Firefighters rescued six people from the building, but four later died of their injuries in hospital.

review.note: Fire service statement reproduced by Xinhua gives 03:54 August 1 local = 19:54 July 31 UTC; six rescued, four died by August 2, two receiving treatment. All material claims match. Only one retrieved publication/source chain; a second independent link is still needed before canonical source replacement. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

07-31.title: Calabar flood and landslide crisis
07-31.description: Weeks of torrential rain in July 2026 caused flooding and landslides across Calabar, killing at least 10 people, including a baby swept away by floodwater and a father buried in mud. The rains destroyed homes, triggered landslides that killed families, and cut off access roads; the toll was cumulative through the end of July.

review.note: Ten is a month-long total published August 1, not deaths on July 31. Primary report supports flooding/landslides but no dated ten-person tally. A defensible onset anchor and overlap with individual incidents remain unresolved.

07-31.title: Iranian strike on Chinese company building in Kuwait kills worker
07-31.description: Kuwait's Defence Ministry said an Iranian attack hit a building belonging to a Chinese company in northern Kuwait on 30 July 2026, killing one worker and causing substantial damage.

review.note: Fatality belongs to July 30 company-building strike, not July 31 base claim; exact clock time unavailable. The proposed July 30 is the reported local occurrence date; UTC conversion remains unverified.

07-31.title: Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
07-31.description: Russian forces launched a ballistic missile attack on Kyiv shortly after midnight on 1 August local time, killing at least nine people and injuring more than 20, including children. Fires broke out across four districts and rescue operations continued through the night.

review.note: Nine dead and 33 injured supported for overnight July 31-August 1. Exact onset for UTC conversion not established. Appears duplicate of 'Russian missile barrage on Kyiv kills ten' dated August 1; reconcile and retain only one incident.

07-31.title: Terrorist attack on labourers in Kulgam
07-31.description: Gunmen shot two workers from Chhattisgarh at a brick kiln in Kelam, Kulgam district, on the evening of 31 July 2026. One died initially and the second later died in hospital, bringing the death toll to two.

08-01.title: European heat wave
08-01.description: Extreme heat affected Europe during summer 2003, with a major peak in August. A retrospective study estimated more than 70,000 excess deaths over the summer, including deaths before August; this is a seasonal excess-mortality estimate rather than a single-day toll.
sources: French Institute for Public Health Surveillance (InVS)

review.note: Peer-reviewed estimate concerns excess mortality over summer 2003; more than 20,000 excess deaths preceded August. August 1 cannot anchor the whole mortality interval without an explicit convention. The air-conditioning/majority claim is unsupported and removed; toll is an estimate, not certified heat deaths.

sources.name: Robine et al., UKHSA research portal
Robine et al., full paper via WMO

08-01.title: Sudan Famine and Humanitarian Crisis
08-01.description: In August 2024, the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) confirmed famine conditions in Zamzam displacement camp near El Fasher, North Darfur — the first famine declaration anywhere in the world since 2011 — amid the civil war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. Independent monitors recorded more than 61,000 people killed in the conflict since April 2023, humanitarian agencies reported child malnutrition deaths in the camp, and the UN said more than 25 million people across Sudan were facing acute food insecurity.

review.note: August 1 is publication of the Zamzam famine determination, not onset of famine mortality. 61,000 is estimated all-cause mortality in Khartoum State over April 2023-June 2024, not recorded killings nationwide or famine deaths in Zamzam. First famine since 2011 is false (South Sudan 2017); a famine-specific death total is not established. Do not repurpose the unrelated mortality estimate.

sources.name: United Nations - South Sudan famine declaration

08-01.title: Assam flood death toll reaches 82
08-01.description: Assam's disaster authority reported a cumulative monsoon-flood death toll of 82 by late 31 July 2026. Reports published the next morning said roughly 193,000 people in five districts remained affected. This is a season-to-date toll, not deaths on one day.

review.note: 82 was announced late Friday July 31, reported Saturday August 1. It is season-to-date, not daily deaths. Current affected population was about 193000; 1.1m may refer to another snapshot. District death breakdown not corroborated. The proposed July 31 is a reporting snapshot, not a verified onset. Its Assam component overlaps the India-wide monsoon tally; publication requires a defensible non-overlapping episode boundary.

08-01.title: Bombing at Moscow restaurant kills five
08-01.description: A bomb exploded near the Balzi Rossi restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square in Moscow on the evening of 1 August 2026. Authorities initially reported three deaths, including the woman carrying the device, a security guard and a visitor. A subsequent Russian embassy statement reported five dead and 19 injured.

08-01.title: Israeli strikes kill at least seven in Gaza
08-01.description: Gaza's civil defence reported seven people killed in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip since dawn on 1 August 2026. An Israeli strike also destroyed medical supplies stored for Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, according to hospital and Palestinian health officials.

08-01.title: Plane crash near Nazca kills 13
08-01.description: A small plane crashed in farmland about 6 km from the city of Nazca in Peru's southern Ica region on Saturday, killing all 13 on board — 11 tourists plus the pilot and co-pilot. Local media reported that seven Italians, two Germans and two Spaniards were among the dead; the flight was on a tour route over the Nazca Lines.

review.note: August 1 crash, 13 occupants and tourist nationalities corroborated. Exact six-kilometre location and aircraft timing/UTC not independently established; avoid full verification.

08-01.title: Russian missile barrage on Kyiv kills ten
08-01.description: In a heavy ballistic missile attack early on Saturday, Russia struck Kyiv and the surrounding region, killing 10 people and wounding more than 30. It was the second major attack on the capital that week; President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine had run out of Patriot interceptor missiles.

review.note: Likely duplicate of July 31 'Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv'. Sources report nine, not ten, in the overnight July 31-August 1 attack; ten may be borrowed from July 30 nationwide strikes. Merge after establishing onset; do not sum both records.

08-01.title: Shooting at In-N-Out restaurant in Twin Falls
08-01.description: A shooting near an In-N-Out restaurant in Twin Falls on the afternoon of 1 August 2026 left three people dead and seven injured, according to the city's public update. Police said the immediate threat had ended and the investigation was continuing.

review.note: City and local public radio update injuries to seven. 14:30 MDT is 20:30 UTC August 1. Retrieved accounts vary over whether three deaths include gunman; retain reported three without claiming three homicide victims. Resolve victim/perpetrator breakdown separately. Publication is withheld until the victim/perpetrator scope of the total is reconciled.

08-01.title: Taliban police report killing seven alleged robbers in Kabul
08-01.description: Taliban police said seven men accused of armed robbery were killed during an operation in Kabul's Police District 8 on 1 August 2026. Police described a confrontation at about 21:00 local time. A former Afghan justice minister subsequently described the killings as extrajudicial; the police account was not independently established.

08-02.title: Drone strike on Darfur community court kills at least 46, rights group reports
08-02.description: A drone strike hit Zawiya Ghara community court in North Darfur during a court session on 2 August 2026. Emergency Lawyers initially reported at least 35 deaths. Darfur Victims Support Organization later reported 46 civilian deaths and seven injuries in preliminary documentation based on interviews with families and witnesses. Rights groups attributed the strike to the Sudanese army.

08-02.title: Firefighting helicopters collide in Greece killing two
08-02.description: Two firefighting helicopters collided in mid-air on Sunday while battling a wind-driven wildfire west of Athens, and one caught fire and crashed. A Greek and a Danish crew member died; the two survivors — a Greek and a British national — were taken to hospital in Athens.

08-02.title: Israeli strikes kill 18 in Gaza
08-02.description: Israeli airstrikes across Gaza on 2 August 2026 killed at least 18 Palestinians, including children, according to medics. Strikes hit Gaza City, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis. The toll may overlap the 18 newly killed people in the health ministry's next-day 24-hour bulletin and must not be counted again.

08-02.title: Russian glide bombs kill one in Zaporizhzhia
08-02.description: Russian aircraft dropped eight glide bombs on residential districts of Zaporizhzhia within 90 minutes on Sunday evening, killing a 71-year-old woman, wounding 31 people — including a 16-year-old girl — and damaging 22 apartment buildings in four districts of the city.

08-02.title: Suicide bombing at anti-militant rally kills 14 in Swat
08-02.description: A suicide bomber targeted protesters gathered outside a police station in Kabal, Swat, on Sunday, killing at least 14 people — including eight police officers — and wounding more than two dozen others, officials said. The rally was part of an anti-militant peace campaign in northwestern Pakistan.

review.note: August 2 Kabal rally attack supported. Totals differ: 14, 15 and later secondary 17; police/civilian breakdown and injured counts vary. Do not combine incompatible snapshots. Exact onset unavailable.

08-02.title: Ukraine strikes deep inside Russia kill eight
08-02.description: Large-scale Ukrainian drone strikes on targets deep inside Russia on Sunday killed at least eight people, including at logistics warehouses of retailer Wildberries in the Moscow region. Russia said it shot down 635 UAVs overnight, and the acting governor of the border Belgorod region reported four dead in strikes on civilian areas.

review.note: DW supports eight nationwide but lists Udmurtia and Belgorod, and depicts Wildberries in Samara, not Moscow. AP's next-day account reports nine. Location composition, 635 interceptions, Belgorod four and UTC coverage require reconciliation.

08-03.title: ISIS Genocide of Yazidis in Sinjar
08-03.description: Islamic State fighters attacked the Yazidi community around Sinjar on August 3, 2014, committing mass killings, abductions and sexual enslavement. UN investigators found genocidal acts. Published estimates describe thousands killed, but differ in time span, population and counting method.

review.note: UN accounts give estimates ranging from 2,000-5,500 killed since August 3 and as many as 5,000 men in 2016 remarks, not an exact 2014-2017 total. Genocide finding supported, but numeric scope remains unresolved. No exact UTC onset established.

sources.name: UN Special Adviser on Prevention of Genocide, 2016 remarks

08-03.title: Ludian Earthquake
08-03.description: An earthquake struck Ludian County, Yunnan, on August 3, 2014. China's earthquake authority's August 8 assessment recorded 617 deaths, 112 missing people and 3,143 injuries. The quake destroyed homes and caused landslides.

review.note: 617, 112 missing and 3,143 injured are the August 8 assessment, not an unexplained final count. Replacement keeps those categories distinct and omits unsupported relative ranking; afternoon China event remains August 3 UTC. The August 8 snapshot does not establish the eventual final toll, particularly with 112 then missing; withhold pending final casualty reconciliation.

sources.name: People's Daily/China News Service, official August 8 tally

08-03.title: El Paso Walmart shooting
08-03.description: A gunman targeting Hispanic shoppers attacked the Cielo Vista Walmart in El Paso, Texas, on August 3, 2019. Twenty-three people died and 22 were injured. The attacker pleaded guilty to federal hate-crime and firearms charges and was sentenced in July 2023 to 90 consecutive life terms.

08-03.title: Drone crash on Gelendzhik-area beach kills eight
08-03.description: A drone crashed onto a beach at Arkhipo-Osipovka near Gelendzhik on the morning of 3 August 2026. Later reporting put the toll at eight deaths, including four children, with 58 injured. Russia attributed the drone to Ukraine; whether air defences caused it to crash remained uncertain.

08-03.title: Israeli fire kills 19 Palestinians in Gaza
08-03.description: At least 19 Palestinians were killed by Israeli fire over 24 hours, including 18 killed by Israeli forces and one who died of wounds from an earlier attack, according to the Gaza Health Ministry. The deaths brought the number of Palestinians killed since the ceasefire to more than 1,250.

review.note: Ministry's August 3 release supports 18 newly killed plus one previous-wound death, not 19 deaths necessarily occurring August 3. Likely overlaps August 2 entry's 18. Cannot count both totals independently; exact rolling-window cutoff and unique victims unresolved.

08-03.title: Israeli strike kills two in Gaza City
08-03.description: An Israeli airstrike targeted a vehicle southwest of Gaza City on Monday evening, killing two Palestinians in the Sheikh Ajlin area, in another violation of the ceasefire that took effect in October 2025, medical sources said.

08-03.title: Landslide kills 14 at Ethiopian monastery
08-03.description: Heavy rainfall triggered a landslide that buried worshippers gathered at Tsadqane Debre Mitmaq St. Mary Monastery in Amhara's North Shewa Zone, killing 14 people and injuring at least seven, with an unknown number still missing as search and rescue efforts continued.

review.note: AP's full report supports date, monastery, region, rain, 14 deaths, seven injuries and people unaccounted for. 07:00 local = 04:00 UTC August 3. One retrieved source chain; obtain second independent URL before replacing canonical sources. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

08-03.title: Russian guided bombs kill three in Sumy
08-03.description: Russian guided aerial bombs struck Sumy between 02:08 and 02:17 local time on 4 August 2026 (3 August UTC). The attack killed two girls aged five and ten and a 75-year-old woman, according to Ukrainian reports, and injured other residents. Homes and civilian infrastructure were damaged.

08-04.title: Beirut Port Explosion
08-04.description: An ammonium nitrate explosion at the Port of Beirut on August 4, 2020 killed 218 people and wounded about 7,000, according to Human Rights Watch's investigation.

08-04.title: CRPF officer shooting in Assam kills four
08-04.description: A CRPF officer shot two colleagues dead and seriously wounded another at the 34th Battalion camp in Katimari, Nagaon, before killing himself; the wounded personnel member later died in hospital, bringing the death toll to four, police said.

review.note: Two colleagues and perpetrator dead, one injured supported; August 12 follow-up still describes three. No support located for injured colleague's later death. Morning August 4 may require exact clock for UTC boundary. Any rewrite must use 'died by suicide' without method.

08-04.title: Israeli fire kills two in Gaza
08-04.description: Two more Palestinians were killed by Israeli fire in Gaza over 24 hours, with ten others injured, according to the Gaza Health Ministry, bringing the death toll since October 7, 2023 to 73,377. Some victims remained trapped under rubble beyond the reach of rescue crews.

review.note: August 4 is bulletin date; two newly reported deaths may include the August 3 vehicle strike. Cumulative 73377 corroborated, but exact death dates/unique victims and full injury/rubble claims not established.

08-04.title: Lightning strike kills footballer in Thailand
08-04.description: A lightning strike during a Golok FA Cup match at Santiphap Stadium in Sungai Golok, Narathiwat, on the afternoon of 4 August 2026 killed 24-year-old Yala FC player Sofwan Awae. At least nine others were reported injured.

08-04.title: Russian drone strike on Mykolaiv kills elderly woman
08-04.description: Russian drones attacked the southern port city of Mykolaiv overnight, killing an 89-year-old woman and injuring seven people, including two children. Two private houses were destroyed and several other buildings were damaged.

review.note: Victim age, seven injured including two children, and two destroyed homes supported. Night of August 3-4 not precise enough for UTC day; do not use publication date as onset.

08-04.title: Serviceman kills four in shooting near Sevastopol
08-04.description: A Russian serviceman opened fire on fellow soldiers and civilians in the village of Khmelnitskoye near Sevastopol, killing four people - one soldier and three civilians aged 59, 64 and 71 - and wounding four others before being detained, Sevastopol Governor Mikhail Razvozhayev said.

review.note: Four dead (one soldier/three civilians), four injured and detention supported. AP explicitly says governor did not specify when it happened: August 4 is report date, not proven occurrence date. Victim ages not established.

08-04.title: Ukrainian drone strike on Moscow region kills five
08-04.description: A Ukrainian drone strike on an industrial zone in Novoselki near Chekhov, outside Moscow, started fires at an industrial site and killed five people, wounding at least six others, Moscow Region Governor Andrei Vorobyov said. The attack was part of an escalation of long-range drone strikes exchanged between Russia and Ukraine.

review.note: Governor's five dead/six injured and Novoselki/Chekhov supported. Overnight onset not precise enough to establish August 3 versus 4 UTC; sources share governor statement rather than independent casualty confirmation.

08-05.title: Wisconsin Sikh temple shooting
08-05.description: A white supremacist gunman attacked the Sikh Temple of Wisconsin in Oak Creek on August 5, 2012. Six victims died that day, and Baba Punjab Singh died from complications of his injuries in 2020, bringing the victim toll to seven. The attacker also died by suicide; he is not included in the victim count.

08-05.title: Lombok earthquake sequence
08-05.description: A series of major earthquakes struck the island of Lombok between July 29 and August 19, 2018, the strongest being a magnitude 7.0 quake on August 5. The quakes destroyed more than 70,000 homes, triggered landslides on Mount Rinjani, and killed at least 563 people, including tourists in the Gili Islands, with over 1,000 injured and roughly 350,000 displaced.

review.note: August 5 date and magnitude 7.0 per Indonesian authority supported. 563 is a sequence-wide figure in secondary accounts. Need final BNPB report for death, housing and displacement totals and especially purported tourist deaths in the Gili Islands; sources retrieved do not establish those full-record details.

08-05.title: Explosion in southern Lebanon kills two Israeli soldiers
08-05.description: Two Israeli reservists from Battalion 2855 of the 55th Reserve Paratroopers Brigade were killed and four seriously wounded in an explosion during an operation in Majdal Zoun on 5 August 2026, the Israeli military announced the following day. The circumstances of the explosive device were under investigation.

08-05.title: India monsoon floods and landslides kill more than 100 since July
08-05.description: An official tally released on August 5 showed that floods and landslides triggered by monsoon rains had killed at least 133 people across India since the beginning of July: 87 in Assam (47 in Sivasagar district alone), 31 in Jammu and Kashmir, and 15 in Kerala, with seven people still missing and more than 10,000 in relief camps.

review.note: AFP supports 133 since early July, including 87 in Assam. August 5 is release date, not event date. Assam portion overlaps the 82-death Assam record. Must choose non-overlapping disaster scopes and establish onset; do not add both full tolls.

08-05.title: Israeli airstrike on south Lebanon kills one
08-05.description: An Israeli drone strike hit the roof of a prayer hall at a cemetery in Tebnine, Bint Jbeil district, on 5 August 2026. Lebanon's Health Ministry reported one person killed and twelve injured, updating an initial report of eleven injuries. The strike came as a round of Lebanese-Israeli talks in Rome concluded.

08-05.title: Israeli fire kills four in Gaza
08-05.description: Israel killed four more Palestinians in Gaza over 24 hours, bringing the war's death toll to 73,381, the Gaza Health Ministry said. Since the ceasefire took effect in October 2025, Israeli violations have killed 1,254 Palestinians and injured 4,121.

review.note: All quoted ministry totals supported as an August 5 reporting snapshot, but rolling 24h fatalities cannot all be dated August 5. Unique victims and overlap with incident-level entries not established.

08-05.title: Mass shooting in Caswell County, North Carolina kills three
08-05.location: Caswell County, North Carolina, United States
08-05.description: A mass shooting at a rural home in Caswell County, North Carolina, left three family members dead - including the suspected shooter - and a fourth relative hospitalized, according to the Caswell County Sheriff's Office and the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation.

08-05.title: Mudslide buries household in Zhashui County, Shaanxi
08-05.description: A sudden mudslide triggered by days of heavy rainfall buried members of a household in Xingping township, Zhashui County, while they were clearing water near their home on August 5. One person was confirmed dead and two remained missing; continuous rain from July 30 to August 5 reached 321.4 mm in the county.

review.note: Xinhua's August 6 dispatch quotes the county flood-control headquarters: the household was buried August 5, with one confirmed dead and two missing. It also supports the July 30-August 5 maximum rainfall figure. Missing people are not included in lives_lost. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

08-05.title: Rain-triggered house collapse kills six in Pratapgarh, India
08-05.description: A house collapsed during heavy rain in Mahuli, Pratapgarh district, at about 2 a.m. local time on August 6, killing six members of a family, including two young children.

08-05.title: Russian missile strikes on Kyiv kill two
08-05.description: Russia attacked Kyiv with waves of ballistic missiles and drones after midnight, killing at least 21 people - three in the capital and 18 in the surrounding region - and injuring more than 45. The assault used 24 ballistic missiles, four Zircon/Onyx missiles and 115 drones, hitting warehouses, a railway station and other civilian infrastructure; air defences intercepted 98 drones.

review.note: Core attack/missile counts supported; sources give 17 combined and later two city deaths, not record 21 with 3+18. Title/number mismatch. Onset after midnight August 5 local implies potentially August 4 UTC; precise onset and final combined toll unresolved.

08-05.title: Russian strike on grain ship in Odesa region kills one
08-05.description: Russian forces attacked a merchant dry cargo ship flying the flag of Guinea-Bissau and loaded with Ukrainian wheat, damaging the hull and starting a fire. One Ukrainian sailor was killed and three crew members were injured; the crew was evacuated to shore.

review.note: Mera Queen, flag, wheat, one killed/three injured supported. Odesa report dates strike evening August 5; trade publication uses August 6. Preserve conflict rather than treating report date as proof. Exact UTC date requires primary confirmation.

08-05.title: Sri Lanka floods and mudslides kill seven
08-05.description: Torrential rains triggered floods and mudslides across Sri Lanka's central highlands, killing at least eight people - six in Nuwara Eliya, one in Kandy and one in Puttalam - and affecting more than 16,000 people, with nearly 11,000 evacuated. Authorities closed schools in the affected areas.

review.note: Disaster began before August 5; eight already reported August 4, later nine by August 25. Eight/seven title mismatch. Geographic and time windows differ; exact onset/toll scope and 11000 evacuated unresolved. Do not treat cumulative impacts as August 5 deaths.

08-06.title: Ethiopia floods (Dire Dawa and Omo Valley)
08-06.description: Unusually intense seasonal rains in August 2006 caused two major flood disasters in Ethiopia: a flash flood of the Dechatu River in the city of Dire Dawa on August 6 killed 256 people with about 250 missing, and flooding of the Omo River in the remote South Omo Valley on August 13 killed 364 people and submerged five villages. Combined flood deaths across the country in 2006 reached about 640, with roughly 118,000 people affected and tens of thousands displaced.
sources: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)

review.note: IFRC's August response reported639, not640; AfDB's full2006 account includes later floods and about900 deaths. Do not merge August and annual scopes. August6 is the local Dire Dawa date, not established onset of all nationwide flooding or confirmed UTC date.

08-06.title: ATF operation in Nashville ends with man and teenager fatally shot
08-06.description: James Salinas, 32, and Denzel Molina, 16, were fatally shot during an ATF firearms operation on Landers Avenue in Nashville on August 6. The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said agents encountered two people and gunfire was exchanged; it was investigating the circumstances. No officers were injured.

08-06.title: Gaza hospitals report one death from earlier wounds
08-06.description: An August 6 medical bulletin reported one Palestinian who died of earlier wounds and five injured people received by Gaza hospitals during the preceding 24 hours. It reported a cumulative death toll of 73,382 since October 2023.

review.note: August 6 is the bulletin date, not a proven death or attack date. The report says one person died of earlier wounds during a rolling 24-hour period; it does not identify Beit Lahia or a new airstrike. Cumulative 73,382 and five wounded are supported. Exact death time and incident linkage remain unresolved.

08-06.title: Russian drone strike on Lozova train station kills two
08-06.description: Russian drones struck railway infrastructure and the station in Lozova on August 6, killing two railway workers aged 52 and 59 and injuring 11 people, according to regional police.

08-06.title: Russian strikes kill six in Balakliia and Sumy region
08-06.description: Ukrainian authorities reported three people killed in overnight strikes on homes in Balakliia and three in attacks in Sumy region. Reuters reported at least 19 wounded in Sumy-region settlements, another 12 in Sumy city, and six in a drone attack on a van in Kherson region.

review.note: Reuters supports six deaths, three each in Balakliia and Sumy region, but says overnight without times to determine August 5 versus 6 UTC. Sumy city's guided-bomb attack injured 12, not 13; not all attacks are established as drones. Compare the separate Lozova entry to avoid combining separate attacks.

08-06.title: Storm deaths in the Philippines reach at least 27
08-06.description: Heavy rains from tropical depressions Luis and Maymay and the enhanced southwest monsoon killed at least 27 people across the Philippines, with 17 injured and one missing, according to the Office of Civil Defense on August 19. About 5.39 million people were affected across Luzon and Mindanao, with nearly 2,000 homes damaged and 461 evacuation centers housing about 42,000 people. Landslides and flooding were widespread, including 10 killed in Baguio City when a rain-drenched mountainside collapsed on three houses.

review.note: The record is a nationwide cumulative storm series, not a discrete Northern Luzon event on August 6. Official reporting begins July 30; the August 20 OCD figure rose to 29 reported deaths, while later reports add other storms and cannot be substituted without matching scope. Reported versus validated counts also differ. Includes potential overlap with August 9 Baguio and Batangas records; do not add all three totals. Resolve episode boundary and validated toll before replacement.

08-06.title: Wildfire kills bulldozer operator in Oregon
08-06.description: Jason Ensign, a 47-year-old equipment operator, died while operating a bulldozer at the Wrights Spring Fire in Oregon on August 6. Rapid fire growth cut off his escape route while he helped construct fire lines.

08-07.title: Russo-Georgian War
08-07.description: Heavy fighting began around Tskhinvali in South Ossetia on the night of August 7-8, 2008 and expanded into a five-day war involving Georgian and Russian forces and separatist forces. The EU fact-finding mission estimated about 850 deaths across the conflict from the parties' reported losses and said far more than 100,000 civilians fled their homes.
sources: EU Independent International Fact-Finding Mission: volume I
Human Rights Watch: Up in Flames, January 2009
Human Rights Watch: cluster-munition investigation, April 2009

08-07.title: Zhouqu mudslide
08-07.description: Heavy rain triggered devastating debris flows in Zhouqu, Gansu, around midnight on August 7-8, 2010 local time (August 7 UTC). Mud and rock swept through the town and blocked the Bailong River. NASA's retrospective, citing landslide research, reports a toll of 1,765; this is not a separately reconciled count of confirmed dead and missing.

review.note: 1,557 + 284 equals 1,841, not 1,765. NASA and research report 1,765; do not retain the inconsistent confirmed/missing breakdown. Around midnight August 7-8 China time is August 7 UTC. The proposed 1,765 remains unreconciled with the competing confirmed-dead/missing breakdown; shortening the prose does not resolve that numeric field. Withhold pending a consistent casualty definition.

08-07.title: Firefighting helicopter crash near Utah wildfire kills two
08-07.description: Two pilots died when a contracted CH-54A firefighting helicopter crashed near Kanosh at about 10:41 a.m. local time on August 7 while dropping water on the Widemouth 2 Fire.

08-07.title: Thailand school shooting kills nine
08-07.description: A student killed his grandparents before attacking Debsirin Nonthaburi School on the morning of August 7, killing five staff members and injuring more than 20 people. The shooter also died. A wounded pupil died on August 8, bringing the reported total, including the shooter and the grandparents, to nine.

08-08.title: Pushkin Square bombing
08-08.description: A bomb exploded in a pedestrian underpass near Moscow's Pushkin Square during the evening rush hour on 8 August 2000. Officials investigated several possible motives; no group claimed responsibility at the time.

review.note: Contemporary reporting supports date, rush-hour underpass attack and explicitly uncertain responsibility. It gives preliminary deaths, not the later 13. Remove definitive Chechen linkage; final toll still needs a reliable later source.

08-08.title: Typhoon Morakot
08-08.description: Typhoon Morakot, the deadliest typhoon to hit Taiwan in about 50 years, made landfall on August 7-8, 2009, dumping record rainfall of up to 3 meters in the southern mountains. A massive mudslide buried the village of Xiaolin in Kaohsiung County, killing an estimated 400-500 residents. More than 670 people were confirmed dead in Taiwan, with additional deaths in China and the northern Philippines, for a regional total of roughly 700-800 lives lost.
sources: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs

review.note: Taiwan reconstruction record lists 681 dead and 18 missing separately; paper dates the typhoon strike to August 7. Existing 700 is an untraceable rounded regional total. Need landfall time/UTC, final cross-country sum and Xiaolin toll before replacing date or numeric field.

08-08.title: Maui wildfire
08-08.description: A wildfire that began near Lahaina, Maui, on the morning of August 8, 2023 local time later spread through the town. Investigators found that broken electrical lines started the fire and surviving embers rekindled in strong winds. The confirmed toll reached 102 after a later death was attributed to fire injuries in June 2024.

08-08.title: Explosive drone attack on police substation kills officer in northern Colombia
08-08.description: Explosives dropped from drones struck the San Roque police substation in Curumani, Cesar, killing one officer and wounding another. Local reporting places the attack on the night of August 7.

review.note: Local follow-up dates the attack to the night of August 7; without an hour, August 7 versus 8 UTC remains unresolved. One officer killed and another wounded are supported. Remove unrelated tollgate and presidential-term detail rather than treating those as evidence of this incident's date.

08-08.title: Helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro kills four
08-08.location: Alto da Boa Vista, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
08-08.description: A Robinson 44 helicopter crashed in a forested area near Vista Chinesa in the Tijuca National Park in Rio de Janeiro on Saturday morning, killing all four people on board, firefighters said.

08-08.title: IS-linked militants kill at least 13 in eastern Congo village attack
08-08.location: Banana École, Mambasa, Ituri, DR Congo
08-08.description: An attack attributed to ADF militants killed at least 13 civilians in Banana Ecole, Mambasa territory, Ituri. Local reporting described homes and vehicles burned and villagers abducted. Reports disagree whether the attack occurred August 7 or 8.

review.note: Both sources support at least 13 killed and attribution to ADF/IS-linked militants. AP reports Saturday, whereas the local report explicitly says Friday August 7 around 19:00 local (17:00 UTC). This is not merely a publication-date difference that can be silently resolved. Omit the imprecise Uganda-border characterization.

08-08.title: Russian drone strike kills three in Brovary district
08-08.description: A Russian drone strike destroyed a family home in Brovary district, killing a three-year-old child and his grandparents. Three other family members and a neighbor were hospitalized.

review.note: Three deaths are supported for Brovary, while the wider Kyiv/capital-region total later became four. Do not substitute the wider toll into this narrower record. Later police reporting has four injured, not three. The overnight attack needs a time to distinguish August 7 from 8 UTC.

08-09.title: Sbarro Pizzeria Bombing
08-09.description: A suicide bombing at the Sbarro pizzeria in Jerusalem on 9 August 2001 killed 15 civilians initially and wounded about 130. Chana Nachenberg died in May 2023 after remaining unconscious since the attack, bringing the victim toll to 16, excluding the bomber.

08-09.title: Saada school bus airstrike
08-09.description: A Saudi-led coalition airstrike hit a school bus at Dahyan market in Saada Governorate on August 9, 2018. The ICRC relayed a local-authority tally of 51 dead, including 40 children, and 79 injured.

08-09.title: Voepass Flight 2283 Crash
08-09.description: Voepass Flight 2283, an ATR 72-500 flying from Cascavel to Sao Paulo-Guarulhos, crashed in Vinhedo on August 9, 2024. All 58 passengers and four crew members died. The crash occurred well into the flight, not shortly after takeoff.

08-09.title: Habagat floods and landslides kill three in Batangas, Philippines
08-09.description: Widespread flooding and multiple landslides triggered by the southwest monsoon (habagat) killed three people and left one fisherman missing in Batangas province. One victim, 69-year-old construction worker Teodoro Latumbo, died when a landslide buried his barracks in Barangay Calumala, Santa Teresita, late Saturday night.

review.note: ABS-CBN supports a provincial total of three reported August 9, but its accessible page lacks the narrative needed to date each death. Manila Bulletin places Latumbo's death Saturday night August 8, not August 9. Full three-death chronology remains unresolved. These deaths potentially overlap the nationwide Luis/Maymay/monsoon cumulative record. The provincial/nationwide casualty overlap remains unresolved.

08-09.title: Houthi strikes on Mokha kill at least seven in Yemen
08-09.description: Houthi ballistic missile and drone attacks on the western port city of Mokha on Sunday killed at least seven people - three civilians and four military personnel, according to medical sources - and wounded about 15 others, some critically. The Houthis launched a fresh round of strikes hours later.

review.note: August 9 attack is supported, but later accounts conflict: Reuters quotes the military's seven deaths/30 injured; Anadolu has seven/35; AFP via South24 reports eleven (three civilians, eight military)/32. The record's seven/15 is preliminary and may omit later attack waves. Establish whether the intended scope is the first strike or all Sunday attacks before selecting a replacement toll.

08-09.title: Israeli strikes kill three Palestinians in Gaza
08-09.description: Israeli strikes across the Gaza Strip killed three Palestinians and wounded nine others on August 9, targeting civilian neighborhoods, displacement camps and areas previously designated as safe, amid ongoing violations of the ceasefire agreement. Gaza's Health Ministry put the cumulative death toll at 73,386.

review.note: The August 9 WAFA bulletin reports two deaths received in 24 hours, including one from earlier wounds, not three new strike deaths on that date. It supports cumulative 73,386. The cited same-day gunfire report describes three injuries, not deaths. Incident-specific support for three killed, nine wounded, and the asserted target locations was not established; do not infer those from cumulative totals.

08-09.title: Landslide on rain-soaked hillside in Baguio kills 10
08-09.description: A landslide struck houses in Guisad Surong, Baguio, on the evening of August 9 during prolonged monsoon rain. By early August 11, rescuers had accounted for all 13 reported victims: ten died and three survived.

08-09.title: Russian missile strike on Kharkiv apartment block kills two
08-09.description: Russian missiles struck a high-rise apartment block in Kharkiv's Saltivskyi district on Sunday morning, August 9, killing two people, two men aged 50 and 66, and injuring more than a dozen others, according to regional head Oleh Syniehubov.

08-09.title: Sofa factory fire in Riyadh kills 16 Bangladeshi workers
08-09.description: A fire broke out on Sunday at a sofa manufacturing factory in the Musa Sanaiya industrial area of Riyadh, killing at least 16 Bangladeshi migrant workers, according to Bangladesh's Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry. Ten of the victims were from the Naogaon district and others from Natore and Rajshahi.

08-09.title: Two tribal elders shot dead in South Waziristan, Pakistan
08-09.location: Toi Khulla, Lower South Waziristan, Pakistan
08-09.description: Unidentified gunmen killed tribal elders Haji Gul and Malik Badshah while they traveled toward Zarmilan in Lower South Waziristan on August 9. Police said the attack occurred near Darozanda in Toi Khulla tehsil; both men belonged to the Suleman Khel tribe.

08-09.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Belgorod kills six
08-09.description: Russian authorities reported six people killed in a drone attack on Belgorod during the night of 8-9 August 2026. The toll increased after another body was recovered from an apartment building. Russia attributed the attack to Ukraine.

review.note: The death toll rose from three to five and then six. Interfax's August 9 evening report attributes the sixth death to recovery of another man's body from the damaged apartment building, citing the regional operational headquarters. This is an update to the same overnight August 8-9 attack, not an additional incident. Exact fatal-strike timing remains insufficient to select August 8 versus 9 UTC; publication remains withheld.

08-10.title: Typhoon Saomai strikes China
08-10.description: Typhoon Saomai made landfall in Zhejiang on August 10, 2006. The Hong Kong Observatory's annual account records at least 460 deaths across Zhejiang, Fujian and Jiangxi, about two million people evacuated and 60,000 houses destroyed.

08-10.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake in western Colombia kills at least 331
08-10.location: Western Colombia (Choco; Cali, Pereira, Manizales, Quibdo)
08-10.description: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia at 12:34 UTC on August 10, with its epicenter near San Jose del Palmar, Choco. UNGRD's September 3 assessment reported 331 deaths and 466,606 people affected. Buildings collapsed and landslides damaged communities in the affected region.

08-10.title: Murder-suicide at Chicago elementary school leaves two custodians dead
08-10.description: A shooting at Mark Twain Elementary School in Chicago's Garfield Ridge neighborhood on August 10 killed custodian Amalia Bautista Perez, 48, and her 63-year-old coworker. The medical examiner classified their deaths as homicide and suicide respectively. No children were in the school.

08-10.title: Palestinian girl dies of wounds from Israeli fire in Gaza
08-10.location: Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, Gaza Strip, Palestine
08-10.description: Thirteen-year-old Saba Naim Abdullah al-Hashash died on August 10 from wounds sustained when Israeli forces shot her several days earlier in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, according to WAFA.

08-10.title: Russian artillery strike on Buhaivka village in Kharkiv region kills five
08-10.location: Buhaivka, Chuhuiv district, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine
08-10.description: Russian forces carried out a massive artillery strike on the residential area of the village of Buhaivka in the Chuhuiv district of Kharkiv Oblast on August 10, killing five people and destroying several houses, according to regional authorities and the prosecutor's office.

08-10.title: Russian strike on Zaporizhstal kills eight workers
08-10.description: A Russian ballistic-missile attack struck the Zaporizhstal steel plant around 00:30 local time on August 11, or August 10 UTC. The plant later reported eight employees killed and 26 injured in that attack, which halted production.

08-10.title: Russian-installed official reports fatal drone strike on Donetsk fuel station
08-10.description: Denis Pushilin, the Russian-installed head of occupied Donetsk, said a Ukrainian drone struck a fuel station in the city's Proletarsky district on August 10, killing a 45-year-old truck driver and wounding an employee.

review.note: The report supports the August 10 claim, 45-year-old truck driver killed and station employee wounded, but derives entirely from the Russian-installed official. No independent confirmation was located. Describe it as his allegation rather than presenting responsibility as independently established. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

08-10.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk kills 13
08-10.description: A Ukrainian drone attack struck Nizhnekamsk on the morning of August 10. Russian authorities reported 13 deaths and 78 injuries. Ukraine said it targeted an oil refinery in the city.

review.note: Later AP reporting gives 13 killed and 78 injured, superseding 39 injured. Remove the ranking and unsupported child detail from the replacement. Russian officials reported casualties; Ukraine said it targeted a refinery, so do not independently assert intentional civilian targeting. Other retrieved reporting describes the night leading into August 10. No sufficiently precise fatal-strike time was established to distinguish August 9 from 10 UTC; withhold despite the supported toll update.

08-11.title: East Azerbaijan earthquakes
08-11.location: Ahar and Varzaqan, East Azerbaijan, Iran
08-11.description: On 11 August 2012, twin earthquakes of magnitude 6.4 and 6.2 struck 11 minutes apart near the cities of Ahar and Varzaqan in northwestern Iran. At least 306 people were killed and more than 3,000 injured, with thousands of buildings destroyed or damaged in rural villages across the region and at least 80 aftershocks following.

review.note: Date, twin-event identity and reported 306 deaths corroborated in preliminary material. Magnitudes vary by agency/scale; exact 6.4/6.2, final injuries and aftershock count need labeled sources. A preliminary report is not final validation.

08-11.title: Ferry capsizes on Lake Kariba killing 46
08-11.description: An overloaded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba on August 11 after encountering strong waves. Police reported 46 deaths by August 13, while the disaster-management agency said 77 people had been rescued. Authorities had not established a definitive passenger or missing-person count.

08-11.title: Ferry fire off Bali kills one
08-11.description: The Putri Yasmin ferry caught fire between Bali and Lombok around 4:15 a.m. local time on August 12, or August 11 UTC. Rescuers evacuated 211 people and recovered a 19-year-old Indonesian woman's body, authorities reported.

08-11.title: Flash floods in Adré kill three
08-11.description: Heavy rains in the afternoon triggered flash floods in several neighborhoods of Adré, a town in the Assoungha department of Ouaddaï Province in eastern Chad, killing three people; local media reported five people were swept away by the water.

review.note: The local August 12 report explicitly dates the rain and flooding to the afternoon of August 11 and supports the town/department/province. Witness accounts describe five swept away, three dead and two rescued; do not treat all five as deaths. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

08-11.title: Houthi missile strike on cargo ship Tihama in Bab el-Mandeb kills six
08-11.description: Yemen's coastguard reported six people killed, including two rescuers, and ten injured in successive missile strikes on the cargo vessel Tihamah in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait on August 11. Later Indonesian reporting still listed one crewman among the missing, leaving a discrepancy with the initial nationality breakdown.

review.note: August 11 attack and Yemeni coastguard's six reported deaths/ten injuries are corroborated, including two rescuers. However, August 14 Indonesian foreign-ministry reporting still classifies its crewman as missing, whereas earlier reports count him dead. Do not silently resolve that discrepancy or label all six confirmed. A later reconciliation is needed for the confirmed-death total. Ship flag also varies between reports, so omit it.

08-11.title: Landslide on Mumbai chawl kills eight
08-11.description: A rain-triggered landslide struck homes at Gaushiya Chawl in Chirag Nagar, Mumbai, around 3:48 a.m. local time on August 12, or August 11 UTC. The death toll rose to eight before search operations ended on August 13; seven others were injured.

08-11.title: Man kills wife and four children in Winfield, Kansas murder-suicide
08-11.description: Police found Ronald H. Williams Sr., 53, Kelly George, 44, and four children aged three to nine dead in a Winfield home on August 11. Williams had called 911 around 8:50 a.m. saying he had killed his family and intended to kill himself. Police investigated the deaths as a murder-suicide.

review.note: Police identify six dead and an 08:50 local 911 call on August 11, also that UTC date. Retrieved reporting establishes the family deaths but not marriage/parentage for every child; omit those ancillary assertions and the imprecise 'early' qualifier. Total includes the suspected perpetrator. Publication withheld: only one usable evidence document retrieved; a second corroborating source is required.

08-11.title: Russian strike on tanker truck in Odesa region kills two
08-11.description: A Russian strike hit a tanker truck containing oil residue in Odesa region on August 11. Regional administration head Oleh Kiper reported two people killed and three wounded.

08-11.title: Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk region kill five
08-11.description: Russian forces carried out massive strikes on the Dnipropetrovsk region on the evening of August 10 and during the night of August 11, killing five people — including three minors — and injuring seven others, according to Ukraine's Prosecutor General's Office. Regional authorities earlier reported three dead, including a 15-year-old boy, and five injured, with drone and artillery attacks hitting five districts and damaging logistics facilities.

review.note: Primary police report lists four killed across August 10-11, one aged 15, and eight wounded including three children. Prosecutor reporting places the boy's death on the evening of August 10 and two other minors among injured, not dead. AP initially reported three deaths. The record's five dead/three minors is not established, and the aggregate's UTC period is unresolved.

08-11.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Voronezh region kills one
08-11.description: Voronezh governor Alexander Gusev reported one person killed and two injured in an overnight drone attack, with falling debris setting warehouse facilities on fire. His statement was reported August 11.

review.note: Reuters supports one death, two injuries and warehouse fires according to the governor. It describes an overnight attack without enough timing to choose August 10 versus 11 UTC. The victim's precise age/district and national 396-drone total were not established from retrieved evidence; use a narrower description once the date is resolved.

08-12.title: Typhoon Rananim
08-12.description: Typhoon Rananim made landfall in Zhejiang on August 12, 2004, causing destructive winds, floods and landslides. Xinhua's August 16 tally reported 164 deaths and 24 missing in Zhejiang; later summaries give a higher death count.

review.note: 164 dead and 24 missing was the August 16 snapshot, also used by HKO, while later summaries give 168 in China. The 1956 comparison applies to Zhejiang, not all mainland China. Date of landfall is established, but final toll needs reconciliation.

08-12.title: Tianjin warehouse explosions
08-12.description: A fire and explosions at a hazardous-goods warehouse in Tianjin on August 12, 2015, killed 165 people, with eight others missing, according to the official investigation. Another 798 were hospitalized. Investigators traced the fire to nitrocellulose that had dried and self-heated.

review.note: Official investigation distinguishes 165 confirmed dead plus eight missing, including five missing port firefighters. Thus 173 and 104 firefighters include missing presumed dead. Proposed count is confirmed-only; remove unverified explosive quantities. Late night August 12 local remains August 12 UTC. Only one checked source is recorded; the two-source publication minimum is not met.

08-12.title: Beit Lahia drone strike: initial fatality report corrected
08-12.description: A drone strike injured two people in Beit Lahia on August 12, 2026. Anadolu corrected an initial report that one person had died: medical sources instead confirmed that the person was critically wounded. This retained archive entry counts no confirmed deaths from the corrected report; the subsequent outcome is not established.

correction.note: Anadolu explicitly corrected the initial fatality report to a critical injury. Preserve the event as a correction, with zero deaths confirmed by the corrected report, rather than deleting it or counting the withdrawn fatality. This does not establish the victim's subsequent outcome.

original_values.title: Israeli fire kills one in Gaza
original_values.description: An Israeli airstrike on Beit Lahia in the northern Gaza Strip killed one Palestinian and wounded five others, the first reported airstrike in about a week, with the Israeli military saying it targeted a Hamas cell commander. Gaza's Health Ministry put the death toll since October 7, 2023 at 73,388 and the number of wounded at 174,259.

08-12.title: Landslide in Rolpa district kills ten
08-12.description: A landslide triggered by continuous rain swept away nine houses, two cowsheds, a shop and a church in the Kotalbara area of Thabang Rural Municipality in Nepal's western Rolpa district on the night of August 12, 2026, killing 10 people and leaving two missing. Five bodies were recovered at the site and five more were found in neighbouring Pyuthan district, police said.

review.note: August 12 evening at Kotalbara is supported. Initial ten dead/three missing contradicts the record's two missing. Police reported 12 recovered dead and one child missing August 15; August 19 reporting says 13 killed without explaining whether the last missing child was recovered or presumed dead. Confirm that distinction before updating lives_lost. The separate August 13 Sunchhahari landslide is not this event.

08-12.title: Military Apache helicopter crash near Salado kills two
08-12.description: An AH-64 Apache attack helicopter from Fort Hood crashed into a field south of Salado, Texas, around 1:35 p.m. local time, killing both pilots on board and igniting a grass fire that forced nearby residents to flee.

08-12.title: Russian drone strikes on Kherson kill two
08-12.description: Russian strike drones killed two people in Kherson overnight on August 12, including a woman struck inside her home, and wounded others in the Tsentralnyi district, according to regional authorities and military administration head Oleksandr Prokudin.

review.note: The overnight attack killed two, including a woman inside her home, and injured two in Tsentralnyi district. Available reporting does not give the strike time needed to choose August 11 or 12 UTC. A separately reported August 12 afternoon fatal strike must not be silently merged.

08-12.title: Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia region kill one
08-12.description: Russia carried out more than 1,000 strikes on Zaporizhzhia and the surrounding region over the day, killing one person and wounding at least eight, regional governor Ivan Fedorov said. An overnight drone attack destroyed the Epicentr shopping center in the city, sparking a large fire and power outages, and damaged residential buildings.

review.note: The 1,000-plus strikes and one death refer to August 11, reported August 12, with nine wounded. The Epicentr attack is a separate overnight event. The record conflates a daily casualty aggregate with the shopping-center strike; the fatal incident time/identity must be resolved before assigning a single UTC date.

08-12.title: Severe storms and tornadoes kill three in US Midwest
08-12.description: Three deaths were reported amid the August 11 Midwest storms: a child struck by a falling tree in Indiana, a person killed in a Portage house explosion whose cause was under investigation, and an Ohio resident whom emergency responders could not reach because of flooding.

review.note: Reports published August 12 describe Tuesday August 11 storms. Three associated deaths are reported, but the Portage house-explosion cause was still being investigated and the Ohio death was an indirect emergency-access death. Exact UTC times of the geographically separate deaths were not established. Do not present all three as direct tornado deaths or use publication date as occurrence date.

08-12.title: Ukrainian attacks on Belgorod region kill two civilians
08-12.description: Ukrainian forces attacked Russia's Belgorod region more than 170 times over 24 hours, killing two civilians in the Belgorodsky and Graivoronsky districts and injuring three others, acting Governor Alexander Shuvayev said. RIA Novosti later reported three dead and seven people seeking medical help.

review.note: TASS establishes a past-24-hour bulletin on August 12 with two killed and three wounded, not two deaths necessarily occurring August 12 UTC. The record itself juxtaposes a later three-death report without establishing whether it updates the same incidents. Resolve individual victims and reporting interval before choosing a toll/date.

08-12.title: Ukrainian attacks on Krasnodar region kill three
08-12.description: Governor Veniamin Kondratyev reported three deaths, including an eight-year-old child, and 24 injuries in overnight attacks across Krasnodar region. Novorossiysk's port infrastructure and grain terminals were also damaged.

review.note: Three deaths/24 injuries apply to Krasnodar region, not solely Novorossiysk; the child is specifically linked to the city. Overnight timing leaves August 11/12 UTC unresolved. The supported scope correction below avoids attributing all regional casualties to the port.

08-12.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Crimea kills civilian
08-12.description: A civilian was killed in the village of Novosyolovskoye in the Razdolnensky district of Crimea in an overnight Ukrainian drone attack, regional head Sergey Aksyonov said.

review.note: Both reports relay Aksyonov's claim of one civilian death in Novosyolovskoye during the night leading into August 12. Without an incident time, the UTC date could be August 11 or 12. Attribution is a Russian-installed official's claim, not independent verification.

08-13.title: Central European floods
08-13.description: Days of record rainfall in August 2002 caused catastrophic flooding along the Elbe, Danube and Vltava rivers, inundating Dresden, Prague and other cities. About 110 people died across central Europe and Russia, with damages exceeding $15 billion.

review.note: This is a multi-country, multi-day disaster. 13 August is a reporting/peak date rather than established onset. Sources differ on whether Russian floods are included; the stated location omits Russia despite including it in the toll. No consistent 110-death geographic/time scope or $15bn basis established.

08-13.title: Armed man fatally shot by police at Auckland shopping centre
08-13.description: An armed man fleeing from police was shot and killed at Sylvia Park Shopping Centre in Auckland on Thursday afternoon. Police said the man had stolen an air rifle from a gun shop in Penrose; he was confronted under an overpass and pronounced dead at the scene despite first aid.

08-13.title: Bomb blast kills defected naval officer in Sevastopol
08-13.description: An explosion in Sevastopol on the morning of August 13 killed a Russian naval officer later identified in reporting as Robert Shageyev, a former Ukrainian submarine commander who defected in 2014. Russian authorities said they detained a woman and alleged Ukrainian intelligence involvement; that allegation was not independently verified.

08-13.title: Car crash into truck in Nagpur kills two students
08-13.description: Two 17-year-old students died and a third teenager was seriously injured when their car hit a stationary truck in Nagpur early on August 12 local time. Police said they had gone for a drive while waiting for a friend's birthday celebration.

review.note: NDTV's August 13 article explicitly says early Wednesday morning, August 12, and local August 12 reporting corroborates that day. UTC could be August 11 or 12 without the crash time. Two dead and one injured are supported. The teenagers were taking a drive while awaiting a birthday celebration, not necessarily traveling to the party.

08-13.title: Explosion at Fujian shipyard kills firefighter
08-13.description: A fire at Huahai Shipyard in Gantang, Fu'an, began at 13:09 local time on August 13. An explosion at 14:10 injured ten firefighters and two other people; one firefighter died in hospital that evening. Authorities were investigating the cause.

08-13.title: Explosion at Port of Rotterdam kills one
08-13.description: An explosion at the Port of Rotterdam in the Netherlands killed at least one person and injured several others on August 13, 2026. Dutch regional broadcaster Rijnmond reported the blast occurred at around 11:30 a.m. local time; Rotterdam police said the cause remained under investigation and emergency services scaled up their response.

08-13.title: Explosion during ordnance disposal in Sevastopol kills five
08-13.description: Five people were killed on August 13, 2026, during the clearance and disposal of explosive ordnance following a Ukrainian UAV attack on Sevastopol, Russian media reported. Four of the dead were pyrotechnicians of the Russian Ministry of Emergency Situations (EMERCOM) and one was a security guard.

review.note: EMERCOM confirms four personnel deaths and Reuters adds the security guard, quoting the governor's disposal-after-drone-attack account. EMERCOM says the night of August 13 without an exact time, so August 12 versus 13 UTC remains unresolved. Crimea should be identified as occupied Ukrainian territory.

08-13.title: Fire at Greater Noida wood-cutting shop kills one worker
08-13.location: Shahberi, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
08-13.description: A fire at a wood-cutting shop in Shahberi, Greater Noida West, left Altamas dead and Aman injured. Police said both were rescued unconscious and taken to hospital after the overnight fire on August 13-14.

review.note: PTI dates the fire to the intervening night of August 13-14, not a precise time. One died; the other was later stable, not necessarily still critical. An exact time is needed for UTC. Full ThePrint open was denied; indexed PTI text supports the incident and rescue.

08-13.title: Firecracker factory explosion near Sivakasi kills two workers
08-13.description: Two men died after an explosion while testing a new chemical-mixing machine at a fireworks factory near Sivakasi on August 13. One died at the site and the second in hospital. Police opened an investigation into the cause.

08-13.title: Israeli strikes kill two Palestinians in Gaza
08-13.description: Israeli strikes killed Gaza police official Jamal Abu Kamil in Gaza City and Hudhaifa Kawara in Khan Younis on August 13, according to Palestinian medical and interior-ministry sources. Israel said Abu Kamil was a Hamas commander.

08-13.title: Landslide and water seepage in Chamoli tunnel kills seven workers
08-13.description: A sudden influx of water and debris entered the Vishnugad-Pipalkoti project's unfinished tunnel in Chamoli around 6:20 p.m. local time on August 13. At least seven workers died and others were injured, with searches continuing for missing workers.

08-13.title: Mudslide in Changxing, Zhejiang kills one and leaves three missing
08-13.description: A rain-triggered mudslide collapsed a house in Tanlongqiao village, Heping town, Changxing, around 6:30 a.m. local time on August 14, or August 13 UTC. County authorities reported one confirmed death and three people missing that afternoon.

08-13.title: Multi-vehicle crash near Accra kills at least 11
08-13.description: A multi-vehicle collision on the Accra-Kumasi highway at Ofankor Barrier in Ghana's capital killed at least 11 people and injured 13 others in the early hours of August 13, 2026, according to the Ghana National Fire Service. The service said it received a distress call at about 4:00 a.m. local time regarding the collision.

08-13.title: Record rainfall in Chiba kills thirteen
08-13.description: Record rainfall on August 13-14 flooded communities in Chiba Prefecture. The governor reported thirteen deaths, one person missing and damage to more than 4,500 homes by August 27.

08-13.title: Russian drone and missile attack on Zaporizhzhia kills five
08-13.description: Russian forces launched a combined drone and missile attack on Zaporizhzhia in the early hours, damaging buildings and industrial facilities and causing fires and power outages. Five people were killed and at least 20 were injured, according to the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration, Ivan Fedorov.

review.note: The matching five-dead/20-injured report is dated August 11, with its update at 02:10 local, and describes the August 10-11 attack. This strongly duplicates the original August 11 'Russian combined strike on Zaporizhzhia kills seven' row, whose toll later reached eight and UTC date is August 10. No separate August 13 five-death event was established. Withhold this duplicate candidate pending identity reconciliation; do not publish both.

08-13.title: Russian drone strike on passenger train in Odesa region kills two
08-13.description: A Russian drone struck a passenger train in Berezivka district, Odesa region, on August 13, killing the driver and his assistant. Authorities evacuated the 340 passengers, including 67 children; no passengers were reported injured.

08-13.title: Suspected murder-suicide shooting on Staten Island kills two
08-13.location: Staten Island, New York, United States
08-13.description: Police responded to a shooting at a Garth Court home on Staten Island around 11:10 a.m. on August 13. Dana Foley, 39, died at the scene, while Dakota Suckstorff, 27, died after being taken to hospital. Police investigated a suspected murder-suicide.

08-14.title: Qahtaniya Yazidi community bombings
08-14.description: Coordinated suicide vehicle bombings struck Yazidi communities near Sinjar, including Qahtaniya and Jazira, on August 14, 2007. Hundreds of people died. Published mortality figures differ substantially, and the exact total remains unresolved in this audit.

review.note: IBC currently records516-525, versus796 in secondary summaries attributed to Red Crescent and lower government/early counts. Primary Red Crescent documentation establishing796 was not located. Event date/towns and coordinated attacks supported; final count and1,500 injuries unresolved.

08-14.title: 2011 Pakistan monsoon floods
08-14.description: Heavy monsoon rains from mid-August to mid-September 2011 caused severe flooding across southern Pakistan, with the province of Sindh the hardest hit, followed by Balochistan. The official damage assessment recorded 520 deaths (497 in Sindh and 23 in Balochistan), about 9.6 million people affected, and more than 1.5 million homes damaged. The floods destroyed over a million acres of crops and livestock, compounding the effects of the record 2010 floods, and forced roughly 744,000 people to be displaced.

review.note: 520, 9.6 million affected and 744,000 displaced supported. August 14 onset, 497/23 split and timing/housing details were not all established; assessment describes August rainfall across several regions, not a one-day disaster.

08-14.title: Rabaa massacre
08-14.description: Egyptian security forces dispersed the Rabaa al-Adawiya sit-in in Cairo on August 14, 2013. Human Rights Watch documented at least 817 people killed there and judged the actual toll likely above 1,000. These figures concern Rabaa, not the separate al-Nahda dispersal or all deaths across Egypt that day.

review.note: 817 is HRW's documented Rabaa minimum; more than 1,000 is its likely total, not an exact count. Original mixes Rabaa, Nahda and broader official figures. Proposed text separates scope, but the schema's exact lives_lost=1000 remains an estimate needing an explicit editorial counting policy. Only one checked source is recorded; the two-source publication minimum is not met.

08-14.title: Freetown mudslide and floods, Sierra Leone
08-14.description: A major landslide entered the Babadorie River valley near Freetown on August 14, 2017, worsening widespread flooding. The World Bank assessment records about 6,000 people affected across the Western Area and 1,141 declared dead or missing, without equating all missing people with confirmed deaths.

review.note: The August 14 landslide and flooding are supported, but 1,141 explicitly combines dead and missing, not confirmed deaths. The assessment concerns the wider Western Area disaster, not solely Regent. No reconciled confirmed-death total was established here. Remove unsupported orphan and displacement counts while retaining the documented affected scope.

sources.name: World Bank damage and loss assessment

08-14.title: Haiti earthquake
08-14.description: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck southwestern Haiti on August 14, 2021, destroying thousands of homes and damaging infrastructure. The IFRC subsequently reported 2,248 deaths and 12,763 injuries. These are later reported totals, rather than the initial rescue-period count.

08-14.title: Coal mine explosion in Cucunuba kills six miners
08-14.description: Six miners died in a methane-associated explosion at the Porvenir 1 coal mine in Cucunuba on August 14. Colombia's National Mining Agency confirmed the deaths and ordered operations suspended pending compliance with safety requirements.

08-14.title: Helicopter crash in Sehmatal, Saxony kills pilot
08-14.description: A helicopter crashed and caught fire during forestry work near Neudorf in Sehmatal on the morning of August 14. Workers pulled the 29-year-old pilot from the aircraft, but he died at the scene. Police received the report at 9:55 a.m. and opened an investigation with the aviation accident authority.

08-14.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Flores kills at least 68
08-14.description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck near Flores at 21:58 UTC on August 14, or 5:58 a.m. local time on August 15. BNPB reported 68 identified deaths by August 17. The earthquake damaged buildings, triggered landslides and small tsunami waves, and displaced residents.

08-14.title: RSF attack on Um Arada reportedly kills at least eighteen
08-14.description: An RSF attack on Um Arada southwest of El Obeid on August 14 killed at least eighteen people and wounded seventeen, according to local-source reporting carried by Europa Press. Rights and local reports documented more than fourteen civilian deaths and displacement toward El Obeid.

08-14.title: Russian double drone strike on Sumy region kills woman and nine-year-old boy
08-14.description: Russian forces launched a double strike with jet-powered UAVs on a private home in the Buryn community of Ukraine's Sumy region early on August 14, 2026, killing a 29-year-old woman and her nine-year-old son and wounding four others, including the boy's father and grandmother who were hospitalized with severe burns. The attack caused extensive damage and sparked a fire, according to the Sumy Regional Military Administration.

08-14.title: Russian glide bomb hits apartment block in Donetsk region, killing one
